prompt:
[FIGURE PLACEHOLDER: A velocity-time graph for an athlete running along a straight track.
Stage 1 (0 to 4.0 s): straight line from (0 s, 0 m s^-1) to (4.0 s, 8.0 m s^-1).
Stage 2 (4.0 to 10.0 s): horizontal line at v = 8.0 m s^-1.
Stage 3 (10.0 to 12.0 s): straight line from (10.0 s, 8.0 m s^-1) to (12.0 s, 0 m s^-1).]
(a) Calculate the acceleration of the athlete during Stage 1. [1]
(b) State the acceleration during Stage 2. [1]
(c) Calculate the acceleration during Stage 3. [1]
hints: Acceleration is the gradient of each section of the velocity-time graph.
Stage 1 has a positive gradient; Stage 2 is horizontal; Stage 3 has a negative gradient.
teacher_walkthrough: Stage 2: horizontal line gives gradient = 0 m s^-2.
